title: Knowledge Distillation for Semantic Segmentation: A Label Space Unification Approach
mechanism: A teacher in the target taxonomy pseudo-labels other datasets, with each dataset's own GT (mapped) constraining which classes are allowed per pixel; students trained on the union beat the teacher.
evidence: 12 urban and 7 off-road datasets; students outperform teachers (exact numbers not read).
adaptation: Teacher = house 5-seed ensemble. Pseudo-label UCF, MSS, PV-Vision cells in 24 classes: inside UCF crack polygon only crack/inactive allowed; inside MSS/PV-Vision crack mask crack forced; outside any defect GT crack and inactive forbidden.
min_experiment: Arm: student on BenchmarkEL + constrained pseudo-labels, 30k steps, 5 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed (and ensemble teacher). Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 AND E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 AND inactive not up. ~15 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: BRIEF 5 pseudo-label SSL used unconstrained pseudo-labels on unlabelled pool cells (n.d. at 100%); GT-constrained labels on external labelled sets are a different mechanism
